title: Direct Bioprinting of 3D Multicellular Breast Spheroids onto Endothelial Networks
protocol: Dissolve 100 μg of lyophilized EGF in 500 µL of sterile dH2O to make a 200 μg/mL EGF solution.
Add 500 μL of the 200 μg/mL EGF into 4.5 mL of sterile 0.1% BSA in dH2O to prepare a 20 μg/mL EGF stock solution.
Store prepared 20 μg/mL EGF aliquots at -20 °C for up to 12 months.
Dilute 1 mg of hydrocortisone in 1 mL of absolute ethanol to make a 500 μg/mL hydrocortisone solution.
Add 1 mL of sterile DMEM F:12 to the mixture containing hydrocortisone and ethanol to prepare a 500 μg/mL hydrocortisone stock solution.
Store hydrocortisone stock aliquots at -80 °C for up to 12 months.
Dissolve 1 mg of cholera toxin lyophilized powder in 1 mL of sterile dH2O to make a 1 mg/mL cholera toxin stock solution.
Store cholera toxin stock aliquots at -80 °C for up to 12 months.
Add 500 µL of EGF (20 μg/mL) to the medium.
Add 500 µL of hydrocortisone (500 μg/mL) to the medium.
Add 5 µL of cholera toxin (1 mg/mL) to the medium.
Add 500 µL of bovine insulin (10 mg/mL) to the medium.
Add 10 mL of penicillin and streptomycin to the medium.
Add 25 mL of horse serum to the medium.
Mix all components in 500 mL of DMEM F:12 for a final concentration as specified.
Add 500 µL of hydrocortisone (500 μg/mL) to the assay medium.
Add 5 µL of cholera toxin (1 mg/mL) to the assay medium.
Add 500 µL of bovine insulin (10 mg/mL) to the assay medium.
Add 10 mL of penicillin and streptomycin to the assay medium.
Add 25 mL of horse serum to the assay medium.
Mix all components in 500 mL of DMEM F:12 for a final concentration as specified.
Prepare Growth and Assay Medium by adding 50 mL of fetal bovine serum to 500 mL of DMEM.
Add 10 mL of penicillin and streptomycin to the mixture.
Add 25 mL of horse serum to complete the medium preparation.
Seed 500,000 MCF10A or MDA-MB-231 cells in a 10 cm tissue culture dish with 10 mL of growth media.
Wash cells with 10 mL of warm PBS when ready for passage.
Add 2 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA to the dish to detach cells.
Place the dish in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator for 20-25 minutes.
Add 5 mL of MCF10A or MDA-MB-231 Growth Medium to neutralize trypsin.
Pipette the cell-media mixture up and down to resuspend cells and break up clusters.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 1,200 x g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL of MCF10A or MDA-MB-231 Growth Medium.
Plate 1 mL of cell suspension in 5 new 10 cm tissue culture dishes along with MCF10A or MDA-MB-231 Growth Medium.
Place the dishes in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Freeze 200 μL pipette tips for 30 minutes prior to starting the assay.
Keep growth-factor reduced matrix solution (e.g., Matrigel) on ice for the entire process.
Slowly pipette 30 μL of ice-cold matrix solution using ice-cold 200 μL pipette tips into each well of an 8-well chamber slide.
Start from the sides and drag the pipette tip along the corners, adding a final drop to the center of the well to ensure even coating of each well.
Incubate chamber slides in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator for 15-20 minutes to polymerize the matrix solution.
Resuspend trypsinized MCF10A cells in MCF10A Assay Medium at 200,000 cells/mL or resuspend trypsinized MDA-MB-231 cells in MDA-MB-231 Growth Medium at 200,000 cells/mL.
Prepare fresh MCF10A Spheroid Growth Medium by adding 5 μL of EGF (20 μg/mL) and 100 μL of matrix solution to 5 mL of Assay Medium for a final concentration of 2% matrix solution.
Remove the chamber slide precoated with matrix solution from the incubator.
Add 50 μL of MCF10A or MDA-MB-231 cell suspension (10,000 cells) to each well.
If using MCF10A cells, add 450 μL of MCF10A Spheroid Growth Medium.
If using MDA-MB-231 cells, add 450 μL of MDA-MB-231 Growth Medium premixed with 2% matrix solution (9 μL).
Place the chamber slide in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator immediately.
Replace the medium every four days.
Carefully pipette 200 μL of old media out from one corner of each well using a 200 μL pipette tip.
Tilt the chamber slide at 45° to ensure that the spheroids are not disturbed during medium replacement.
Add 200 μL of freshly prepared MCF10A Spheroid Growth Medium or MDA-MB-231 Growth Medium previously mixed with 2% matrix solution to each well in drops.

Add the contents of an Endothelial Growth Medium-2 kit, including insulin growth factor, fibroblast growth factor, vascular endothelial growth factor, ascorbic acid, epidermal growth factor, heparin and gentamicin-amphotericin B, along with 50 mL fetal bovine serum, 5 mL penicillin-streptomycin, and 5 mL of 200 mM glutamine to 500 mL Endothelial Basal Medium-2 (EBM-2) to create complete EGM-2.
Seed 500,000 endothelial cells in a 10 cm tissue culture dish with 10 mL EGM-2.
Place cells in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator until they reach >80% confluency (around 48 hours).
Wash endothelial cells with 10 mL warm PBS for passage.
Add 2 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA to the tissue culture dish to detach HUVEC.
Monitor cells by phase contrast microscopy until they are balled up but remain attached to the dish.
Aspirate trypsin out of the dish.
Add 8 mL EGM-2 to the dish and pipette up and down over the entire surface to wash cells off, or add 5 mL EGM-2 to neutralize trypsin in the cell-media mixture.
Centrifuge at 1,200 x g for 3 minutes to pellet the cells after washing.
Aspirate supernatant carefully and resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL of EGM-2.
Add 1 mL of cell suspension to 9 mL of EGM-2 in a 10 cm tissue culture dish.
Place the dishes in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Exchange 2/3 of the medium with fresh EGM-2 every 2 days.
Freeze 200 μL pipette tips for 30 minutes prior to starting the assay.
Keep growth-factor reduced matrix solution (10 mg/mL) on ice throughout the process.
Pipette 30 μL of ice-cold matrix solution into each well of an 8-well chamber slide using a cold 200 μL pipette tip.
Incubate chamber slides in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator for 15-20 minutes to polymerize Matrigel.
Pre-stain a 10 cm dish of HUVEC with 10 μL of red cell tracker (1:1000) for 30 minutes in 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Wash endothelial cells with 10 mL of warm PBS.
Detach HUVEC by adding 2 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA to the 10 cm tissue culture dish.
Place the dish in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator for 5 minutes to fully detach the cells.
Add 5 mL of EGM-2 to the dish to neutralize the trypsin.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 25 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge HUVEC at 1,200 x g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL of serum-free EBM-2.
Count cells using Trypan blue to determine viable cells.
Create a 1 x 10^6 cell/mL solution.
Add 100,000 HUVEC to each well with 200 μL of serum free EBM-2.
Incubate HUVEC in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator.
After 6 hours, image HUVEC networks by phase contrast microscopy.
Estimate the number of breast epithelial spheroids in each well by counting spheroids in representative phase contrast microscopy images.
Cut 0.5 cm off the end of a 1000 µL pipette tip.
Use the cut pipette tip to carefully pipette all spheroids out of the 8-well chamber slide and into a 50 mL tube.
Resuspend spheroids in the selected bioink at 100 spheroids/100 µL.
Pass the spheroid mixture through a 70 µm cell strainer to remove any large or clustered spheroids.
Load the pooled spheroids into a 10 mL sterile syringe and cap it with a 25-gauge sterile needle.
Attach the syringe to the bio-deposition system.
Aspirate the medium off the HUVEC networks in the 8-well chamber slide.
Extrude 100 µL of breast epithelial spheroids onto 6 wells of HUVEC networks at a flow rate of 1 mL/min.
Maintain 2 wells of HUVEC networks as controls.
Add 400 µL of MCF10A Spheroid Growth Medium if using MCF10A spheroids printed on HUVEC networks.
Add 400 µL MDA-MB-231 Growth Medium previously mixed with 2% matrix solution if using MDA-MB-231 spheroids printed on HUVEC networks.
Incubate co-cultures in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator for 24 – 96 hours without media change.
Prepare Immunofluorescence (IF) buffer 10x stock solution by adding sodium azide, bovine serum albumin, Triton X-100, and Tween-20 in 500 mL of 10x PBS. Adjust pH to 7.4.
Store the IF buffer stock at 4 °C for up to a year.
Create a working IF buffer by diluting 50 mL of 10x IF buffer with 450 mL of sterile deionized water.
Store the working IF buffer at room temperature for up to one week.
Prepare 10x PBS-Glycine buffer stock solution by adding glycine to 500 mL of 10x PBS. Adjust pH to 7.4.
Store the PBS-Glycine buffer stock at 4 °C for up to six months.
Create a working PBS-Glycine solution by diluting 50 mL of 10x PBS-Glycine buffer with 450 mL of sterile deionized water.
Store the working PBS-Glycine solution at 4 °C for up to one week.
Aspirate medium from bioprinted 3D co-cultures and rinse three times with warm PBS.
Fix bioprinted 3D co-cultures with 4% paraformaldehyde for 1 h at room temperature.
Rinse samples three times for 20 minutes with 1x PBS-Glycine buffer.
Block samples with IF buffer mixed with 10% goat serum for 90 minutes (primary block).
Follow the primary block with a secondary block using IF buffer plus 10% goat serum and Afﬁnipure Fab fragment (1:100) for 40 minutes.
Label MCF10A spheroids with a primary antibody for integrin α6 (1:100) in secondary blocking buffer overnight at 4 °C.
Incubate labeled samples with an Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody (1:200) and Hoescht 33342 (1:1000) for 1 hour at room temperature protected from light.
Wash MCF10A spheroids with 1X PBS-glycine three times for 20 minutes each.
Prepare MCF10A samples for mounting by removing the chamber slide using the manufacturer’s tool.
Add a small drop of antifade solution to each well containing MCF10A spheroids.
Place a 22 mm x 60 mm coverslip on each chamber slide and seal the edges with clear nail polish.
Image MCF10A samples using a confocal microscope as Z stacks of approximately 10 slices in 5 μm steps.
Compress Z planes into a single plane using the Extended Focus command in cell imaging software if desired.
Label MDA-MB-231 spheroids with Alexa Fluor 488 phalloidin (1:100) and Hoescht 33342 (1:1000) in secondary blocking buffer for 4 hours at room temperature protected from light.
Wash MDA-MB-231 spheroids with 1X PBS-glycine three times for 20 minutes each.
Prepare MDA-MB-231 samples for mounting by removing the chamber slide using the manufacturer’s tool.
Add a small drop of antifade solution to each well containing MDA-MB-231 spheroids.
Place a 22 mm x 60 mm coverslip on each chamber slide and seal the edges with clear nail polish.
Image MDA-MB-231 samples using a confocal microscope as Z stacks of approximately 10 slices in 5 μm steps.
Compress Z planes into a single plane using the Extended Focus command in cell imaging software if desired.
Quantify spheroid adhesion to endothelial networks using Image J.
Set particle size and circularity parameters in the analyze plugin for accurate quantification.
Normalize the number of attached spheroids to the image area.
Quantify the number of adhered spheroids in 4 x 4 tiled images of co-cultures.
Repeat the experiment if the spheroid number is statistically significantly lower than other experiments.
